title: The Star That Vanished—And Left a Radioactive Ghost Signal
hook: A star 75 million light-years away didn't explode—it just disappeared, and now we're picking up phantom radiation from where it used to be.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of a star simply winking out of existence with no explanation, leaving behind an eerie radioactive trace, taps into pure cosmic horror and mystery.

title: The Secret NASA Program That Tracked an Object Beyond Pluto
hook: In the 1980s, a classified NASA project detected something massive beyond Pluto—then the data was classified and the program shut down overnight.
why_this_can_go_viral: Conspiracy and hidden knowledge drive engagement; a secret NASA program tracking an unknown object taps into the 'what aren't they telling us' psychology.

title: The Fermi Paradox Signal That Decoded as a Galactic Warning
hook: In 2016, a signal from deep space was decoded to reveal a simple message: 'Do not answer. They are coming.' Then it stopped forever.
why_this_can_go_viral: A direct, chilling message from space that contradicts decades of SETI optimism—perfect viral horror content.

title: The Dark Matter Wave That Passed Through Earth—And Wiped a Lab
hook: A dark matter detection facility went completely silent for 37 seconds. When it came back, the entire data set was gone—and so was the lead researcher.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines real physics with a dark personal mystery, making the abstract concept of dark matter feel imminently dangerous.

title: The Star That's Glitching—And Each Glitch Gets Closer to Us
hook: A pulsar 4,000 light-years away has been glitching every 3.2 years. Each glitch moves its signal closer to Earth by 0.01 light-years.
why_this_can_go_viral: A ticking clock in space that's accelerating toward us—creates an existential countdown that viewers can't look away from.

title: The Classified Program That Detected an Alien Structure Orbiting Saturn
hook: Declassified documents reveal a 1970s program that detected an artificial object in Saturn's rings—then the photos were destroyed.
why_this_can_go_viral: A classic conspiracy hook with a fresh location—Saturn's rings—that feels both credible and terrifying.

title: The Strange Signal That Matches a Dying Civilization's Last Words
hook: A signal from a galaxy 1.2 billion light-years away was decoded into a repeating phrase: 'We are the last. Do not repeat our mistake.'
why_this_can_go_viral: Emotionally devastating and existentially terrifying—a dead civilization's final warning is peak viral cosmic horror.

title: The Dark Matter Experiment That Opened a Door—Then Sealed It
hook: In 2011, a dark matter detector registered a massive spike. The lead scientist locked the lab and never spoke of it again. He died one week later.
why_this_can_go_viral: A real-world mystery with a fatal outcome—perfect for 'something was found that shouldn't have been' viral narratives.

title: The Asteroid That Carried a Message From Another Solar System
hook: Oumuamua wasn't just a weird rock—it had a pattern etched into its surface that spelled out a galactic coordinate in binary.
why_this_can_go_viral: Takes a well-known object and adds a shocking new detail that turns it into an interstellar calling card.

title: The Fermi Paradox Answer Hidden in a Global Blackout
hook: On August 14, 2003, a massive blackout hit the US. During those 12 hours, a signal from deep space was received—then erased from all records.
why_this_can_go_viral: Ties a real-world event to a cosmic mystery, suggesting a cover-up during a moment of vulnerability.

title: The Star That Exploded—And Left Behind a Perfectly Spherical Hole
hook: A supernova remnant 300,000 light-years away isn't a cloud—it's a perfect sphere of nothing. As if the star was erased, not blown apart.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of a perfectly spherical void where a star should be defies physics and invites endless speculation.

title: The Classified 'Project Starshot' That Almost Launched a Nuke at the Moon
hook: In 1958, the US Air Force planned to detonate a nuclear bomb on the moon—not as a weapon, but as a message. It was approved. Then canceled. Then classified.
why_this_can_go_viral: A real government plan to nuke the moon is both absurd and terrifying—perfect for 'what were they thinking' viral content.

title: The Extinction Event That Only Killed the Animals That Could See
hook: There was a mass extinction 359 million years ago that targeted only creatures with complex eyes. Something in the sky changed—only they saw it coming.
why_this_can_go_viral: A horrifically specific extinction that feels like a targeted attack on perception itself—highly shareable.

title: The Dark Matter Void That's Growing Into the Solar System
hook: A void in the dark matter halo surrounding the Milky Way is expanding. At its current rate, it will reach the Oort Cloud in 500 years.
why_this_can_go_viral: A slow-motion cosmic catastrophe that's already happening—creates a sense of impending doom.

title: The Rogue Black Hole That's Swallowing Stars—and Getting Closer
hook: A rogue black hole 4.3 million solar masses is drifting through the Milky Way, and it's been eating stars along the way. It's now 1,000 light-years from us.
why_this_can_go_viral: A black hole on a collision course with Earth is the ultimate cosmic threat narrative—immediate engagement guaranteed.

title: The Star That's Pulsing in a Pattern That Matches Human DNA
hook: A pulsar 40,000 light-years away is pulsing with a sequence that perfectly matches the base pair pattern of human DNA—four pulses, repeating infinitely.
why_this_can_go_viral: The implication that the universe might contain our genetic blueprint is both beautiful and terrifying—perfect for deep-thinker virality.

title: The Classified Soviet Space Station That Fell With a Secret Cargo
hook: Salyut 7 carried a classified payload when it burned up in 1991. Witnesses reported a green flash before impact—and the cargo was never recovered.
why_this_can_go_viral: A mysterious Soviet space station with an unknown cargo and a strange final flash—conspiracy gold.

title: The Fermi Paradox Filter That's Operating Right Now—On Earth
hook: What if the Great Filter isn't in our future or past—it's here now, and it's built into the way we use technology. We're already in the bottleneck.
why_this_can_go_viral: Makes the Fermi Paradox feel immediate and personal—viewers will feel like they're living through the filter.

title: The Asteroid That's a Perfect Sphere—And It's Spinning Too Fast
hook: Asteroid 216 Kleopatra isn't a jagged rock—it's a perfect dog-bone shape spinning so fast it should tear apart. But something is holding it together.
why_this_can_go_viral: A strangely shaped asteroid that defies physics feels like an artificial object in disguise.

title: The Dark Matter String That's Tied to Earth—And It's Pulling
hook: A filament of dark matter is connecting Earth to a region of empty space. And it's pulling us toward something that isn't there—yet.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of an invisible cosmic string pulling Earth toward an unknown destination is deeply unsettling and visually compelling.
